LanguageData.LW_Designator_Excavate_Desc: Dig soil, marsh, gravel and similar ground for fill material. Leaves poorer terrain behind. Mass is conserved: every bag of fill came from somewhere.
LanguageData.LW_StressLetter_Medium: The land is strained, but not yet critical.
LanguageData.LW_StressLetter_High: High risk: backlash incidents are much more likely.
LanguageData.LW_StressLetter_Critical: Critical! Large artificial farms may collapse in a single backlash.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_StressDecay: Natural stress decay per game hour: {0}
LanguageData.LW_Settings_PerformanceHint: Performance sliders only affect the background pulse, not game rules. Defaults are cheap; on huge maps with huge engineered farms, lower max cells/pulse or raise the interval.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_MaxDegradesPerPulse: Max degrade cells processed per pulse: {0}
LanguageData.LW_Settings_EasyModeHint: For players who want light terraforming without harsh geology. Material and labour costs remain.
